checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: 14:00–16:00 and Clay House Studio both correct.

must.item: Portrait 4:5, soft earthy colours, simple clay bowl
must.why: 512x640 is 4:5; cream with brown tones; line bowl in centre.
All text is clear and well inside the margins.

faults.what: Very plain and monochrome: only cream and brown, with no terracotta or sage. Every text line has the same weight, so there is no hierarchy and the headline doesn't stand out.
The bowl is small and pale, not a prominent centrepiece.

summary: A calm cream and brown flyer with all five text items spelled correctly, a simple line bowl and a 4:5 format. It is a bit plain and lacks visual hierarchy.
